definitions.short: a revolution , i.e. (of the sun) course , (of time) lapse
definitions.full: H8622. tequphah [ תְּקוּפָה ] noun feminine coming round, circuit ; — construct הַשָּׁנָה תְּקוּפַת Exod 34:22 (JE), adverb, at the circuit (completion) of the year , so ׳לִת הַשָּׁנָה 2Chron 24:33; = plural construct הַיָּמִים לִתְקֻפוֺת 1Sam 1:20 ; singular suffix of finished circuit of sun Psa 19:7 (opposed to מוֺצָאוֺ ; compare of moon, בתקופתו Ecclus 43:7).
